scope: Independent drive topology and qualification contract; no changes to CAD, historical exports or source evidence
applicability: Prior noncoaxial drive layout proposal, not current installed CAD. Coaxial motor location, 450/400mm upper loops, kicker placement and independent deployment flange require redesign; numerical qualification targets remain proposed and every gate remains OPEN.
threshold_policy: New numerical acceptance thresholds below are proposed engineering targets, not user-supplied requirements or observed results. Approve them before qualification; do not relax them after a failure without versioning and rerunning affected tests.

current_limits.basis: Commission from selected controller mode, physical torque/current measurements and whole-robot battery budget; endpoint current proxy is not a controller setting

blockers: B1: Parent must build actual downstream drives, pulley lanes, bearings, axial retention and guards; an envelope is not hardware.
B2: Recalculate loaded single-pivot dynamics at Y110/Z170 and -110 degrees with all drives/wiring and trapped-coral load case; release ratio only after current, torque and duty tests.
B3: Obtain chain working ratings and exact #25H SKU; verify 12T rounded hex. Change transmission family or load requirement if ratings fail, not just the visual model.
B4: Replace thin kicker hubs and specify a manufacturable mechanical core/sleeve torque attachment.
B5: Finish chassis-supported stops, positive stow retention, separated side-load supports and containment of replaceable impact faces; no passive-collapse claim.
B6: Define receiver-owned grip and escape envelope, actual sensors and loss-of-power behavior; retained tray/stop/sensor envelopes do not prove handoff or holding.
B7: Close every qualification gate with linked raw evidence and approved inputs; software tests do not close physical gates.

gates.procedure: Freeze revision, chassis/receiver datums, actual weighed mass/COM/inertia, stock certificates, machine capability, battery budget, motor mode, intended season and physical test plan before release testing.
gates.acceptance: Every unknown input has a measured value or an explicitly approved bounded requirement; no null electrical or impact limit at qualification release.
gates.record: Revision hashes, BOM/source receipts, scale/COM data, tolerances, wiring protection, requirement-owner approval and instrument calibration.

gates.procedure: Inspect all five output paths with power isolated; measure bores, gear phase/backlash, seats, thread engagement, inner-race stacks, end float, belt wrap/tension and chain alignment. Spin unloaded at low speed, then rated speed/load in both directions with guards.
gates.acceptance: Measured tooth ratios/signs match contract; no missing driven output, tight spot, tooth skip, derailment, axial migration or fastener loosening. Every load/fit/tension value is inside a verified supplier/design limit, including jam reversal and pivot chain. No improvised SplineXS-to-hex or SplineXL-to-hex substitution.
gates.record: As-built dimension sheet, selected chain/shaft/fastener specifications, shaft/bearing/bolt/tooth calculations, rpm/current traces and pre/post witness marks.

matrix.yaw_zero: Coral long axis parallel to pickup roller shafts (+X); entry is +Y

gates.procedure: Run the floor matrix with actual regulation-size coral and field carpet; then each wall/upright case at measured starting clearance with both left/right approach biases. Record any wall-pushing, tipping or extra chassis maneuver as part of the cycle. Extend speeds and offsets to the approved match envelope before release.
gates.acceptance: Proposed: 20/20 successful captures per cell/case without human intervention, no earlier hard snag or field damage, indexed within 3s of first soft contact. Record autonomous retries; exclude no difficult orientation silently. This sample is not proof of 99% field reliability.
gates.record: Per-trial yaw, offset, speed, coral dimensions/wear, wall distance, float travel, video, timestamps, current, failure type and final pose.

gates.procedure: Safely fixture a wedged entry, stopped kicker, blocked middle/rear roller and blocked bank separately. Test diagonal coral, reversed command, repeated retry and sensor-stuck states with remote stop and commissioned electrical limits.
gates.acceptance: Proposed: detect sustained commanded-motion mismatch within 250ms after the approved transient filter; stop/reverse and eject within 2s in 20/20 recoverable trials per location. Unrecoverable fault latches motor output off after at most two retries. Never fold a trapped coral automatically; no tread slip, belt tooth jump or damage.
gates.record: Fault thresholds/delays, rpm, supply/stator current separately, bus voltage, recovery time, retry count, temperature and damage inspection.

gates.procedure: Identify entry, oriented/seated, held, receiver-gripped, intake-released and receiver-clear states using actual sourced sensors. Run every capture orientation through alignment and receiver transfer, including blocked receiver, early sensor trigger and loss of power.
gates.acceptance: Proposed: final pose within +/-10mm position and +/-5deg yaw of agreed receiver datum, hold for 10s over approved robot tilt/acceleration envelope, and 20/20 handoffs without drop. Receiver confirms positive grip before intake releases or folds; receiver clears before re-acquisition. Loss of power must retain or safely contain coral; no indefinite stalled-motor holding.
gates.record: Receiver envelope/ownership, pose errors, hold loads, sensor part numbers and logic traces, transfer timing, power-loss response and video.

gates.procedure: Check complete hardware/coral/cable swept solids through 0 to -110 degrees and full front-float range at the low pivot. Then perform 200 loaded/unloaded physical cycles, interrupted moves, power loss at mid-stroke and service-pin insertion; test trapped-coral fault without forcing a fold.
gates.acceptance: No collision or pinch, rule-envelope violation, harness tension, belt/chain derailment or unsupported transfer during sweep. Proposed rigid clearance floor is 5mm AFTER tolerance/deflection allowance, larger where required by harness/vendor/rules. Endpoint forces enter chassis-supported stops, not reducer teeth. Operational stow retention and service pin work without electrical holding.
gates.record: Full swept model and tolerance budget, current/position traces, measured clearances, latch/stop loads, cable bend radii and post-cycle inspection.

gates.procedure: After structural review approve effective collision mass, contact normals, speed, allowed damage and stopping travel. Instrument bounded energy steps at 25/50/75/100% of approved energy, three repetitions per step, at kicker, leading face and corner in deployed and mid-fold states. Stop on damage or unexpected load path.
gates.acceptance: Measured peak force/deflection/stop reaction stays within approved nonlinear/fastener/shaft limits; no detached debris, loss of coral containment or damaged roller datums. Replaceable-face damage only within a preapproved, contained service criterion. Re-run capture and drive-interface checks after each series. Low frontal force may oppose stow: do not assume passive folding.
gates.record: Mass/velocity/contact geometry, force-time and displacement-time records, peak vs average force, rebound, high-speed video, dimensional checks and sacrificial-part replacement.

gates.procedure: Repeat independently approved energy ladder from front_hits on left/right outboard cheek and corner contacts, including asymmetric and stowed cases. Instrument both pivot supports and crossmembers for racking.
gates.acceptance: Separated pivot supports and chassis fasteners carry asymmetric side load within approved limits; no permanent bearing-axis misalignment or roller/guard intrusion. No credit for pivot rotation under pure X force, and no automatic half-load sharing between cheeks. Pass capture/drive checks afterward.
gates.record: Side contact position/normal, support reactions, shaft/plate strains or deflections, residual alignment, fastener witness marks and post-impact function.

gates.procedure: Use the approved full-robot battery and match duty profile with all four motors and representative drivetrain load, fresh and sagged battery, high ambient and scheduled jam recoveries. Proposed minimum: three 150s runs with 60s breaks; extend to actual event/service demand.
gates.acceptance: No brownout, thermal derating, protective trip or performance loss. Measured motor/controller/wiring/bearing/tread temperatures remain at least proposed 10C below their verified applicable limits; voltage and aggregate current remain inside approved budget. No holding by continuous stall. Additional endurance: 300 mixed complete acquisition/handoff/stow cycles with zero unrecovered failures, not a statistical field-reliability guarantee.
gates.record: Time-synchronized supply/stator currents, duty, rpm, bus voltage, temperatures, actual cycle distribution, battery state, ambient, faults and post-endurance wear.

gates.procedure: With power isolated and service pin installed, time replacement of a front contact, kicker sleeve/hub, belt/chain and removable pickup cassette using the listed pit tools and spares. Repeat assembly three times by two technicians.
gates.acceptance: Proposed: contact or belt/chain replacement <=5min; complete cassette <=10min. No motor or indexer removal for routine front service, no forced bending, uncontrolled falling mass or dropped captive hardware. Reassembled geometry and tension pass the same inspection and capture checks.
gates.record: Timed work instructions, tool and spare list, removal paths, retorque marks, tension/end-float measurements and recovery run.

gates.procedure: Make bearing-seat, hex-relief, end-tap and PC-fastener coupons before full fabrication. Use router-cut flat aluminum/PC, saw-cut tube and manual lathe/mill finishing; inspect first articles and source certificates. No accurate metal bending assumed.
gates.acceptance: All critical fits meet tolerances derived from actual supplier drawings/load calculations and demonstrated machine capability. No hidden broaching, splining or gear cutting. PC fasteners use compatible flat-underhead washers/standoffs and thermal allowance; respect verified guide edge/hole rules, no conical countersinks or ordinary threadlocker. The old sub-1mm kicker hub wall is not released. Every custom part has a drawing and an achievable inspection method.
gates.record: Stock grade/thickness certificates, coupon measurements, tools/setups, bearing fits, coaxiality/runout, torque settings, dimensional inspection and revision-bound manufacturing files.
